leaves.name: javanpeykarThm111
leaves.doc: javanpeykar-steps: Javanpeykar, Algebra Number Theory 8 (2014), Thm 1.1.1 as printed, with the height identification printed in the same paper (p. 98; arXiv section 2.3 p. 9): for every algebraic closure Qbar of Q (IsAlgClosed, algebraic over Q) and every smooth (relative dimension 1) proper integral projective curve X over Qbar of genus g = dim H^1(X, O_X) >= 1, every tensor-compatible representative W of Pic^0_{X/Qbar} (Jac X), every stable height h of W (IsStableHeightBar: height-fix's printed stable height of a model V of W over a number field L inside Qbar, V_Qbar = W) and the Belyi degree dB (IsBelyiDegree: least positive degree of a Belyi morphism, a finite morphism X -> P^1 = Proj Qbar[X0,X1] whose restriction over P^1 minus {0,1,oo} is locally of finite type and formally unramified in Mathlib's sense, of degree [k(X):k(P^1)]): h <= 13*10^6 * g * dB^5. Implies javanpeykarPrintedMapHF with no other hypothesis (JavanpeykarSteps.javanpeykarPrintedMap_of_thm111: steps (1) X0 x_K Kbar is such a curve, (2) dB <= d and monotonicity, (3) ramification index 1 at closed points implies unramified, (H2) V is a K-form of W). Uniqueness of the printed height (H3) is JavanpeykarSteps.isPrintedStableHeight_unique (given T35, Stacks 04KV, N1, SS2).
